author: AlirezaAlampour
description: V3.1: same 7-layer UNet shared-transformer recipe as V2 (MLP×4, Muon+EMA, Int8 QAT, 4h training). Single change vs V2: validation eval uses stride-64 sliding window instead of chunked (stride = seq_len), matching the upstream 2026-03-19 SlidingWindowEval record (PR #77). 2-seed submission (seed 42 lost to a filename-collision bug, documented in BUGS.md; fix included in train_gpt.py, retrain deferred).
